Dear Litware Ltd,

We have processed your refund of **310** for the incorrect translation fee previously charged. This refund has been linked to your case.

Additionally, we have corrected our systems to ensure all future support communications for this ticket and account will be delivered in **German**, as per your contract.

Thank you for bringing this to our attention. If you have further questions, reply directly to this ticket.

Best regards,
Your Support Team
